purpose: You Were Formed for God’s Family

group.title: Formed For God’s Family
group.point: I was formed for God’s family.
group.question: How can I start treating other believers like members of my own family?

group.title: What Matters Most
group.question: Are relationships my first priority? How can I ensure that they are?

group.title: A Place to Belong
group.point: I am called to belong, not just believe.
group.question: Does my level of involvement in my local church demonstrate that I love and am committed to God’s family?

group.title: Experiencing Life Together
group.point: I need others in my life.
group.question: What one step can I take today to connect with another believer at a more genuine, heart-to-heart level?

group.title: Cultivating Community
group.question: How can I help cultivate today the characteristics of real community in my small group and my church?

group.title: Restoring Broken Fellowship
group.question: Who do I need to restore a broken relationship with today?

group.title: Protecting Your Church
group.point: It is my responsibility to protect the unity of my church.
group.question: What am I personally doing to protect unity in my church family right now?
